written: 2026-09-25, from TD's own use of alacritty_terminal and from the two bake-off harnesses written against rio-vt 0.5.28 and libghostty-vt 0.2.1; not from the research summaries Jev read
rule: pass = provides or provides_with_work; fail = does_not; a label marked 'unsure' is left out of the score

cell_contents: Cell { c, fg, bg, flags } — pane.rs styled_lines reads them
zero_width: Cell::zerowidth() — gridwire.rs re-emits the marks in every snapshot
wide_chars: Flags::WIDE_CHAR and WIDE_CHAR_SPACER — styled_lines skips spacers
scrollback_read: grid[Line(-n)] reads history — TD's FOCUS reader walks it
snapshot: no serializer for the whole state; TD wrote gridwire.rs to re-encode the grid itself
feed_loop: vte::ansi::Processor::advance(&mut term, bytes) — corebake calls it directly
replies_out: Event::PtyWrite through the EventListener — host.rs bounces it
threading: Term is Send; TD shares it behind FairMutex between the reader thread and the UI
placements_readable: no picture state at all — the bake-off measured 0 of 6
placeholders: placeholder cells survive as text but nothing resolves them
media_policy: no picture protocol, so nothing to refuse

cell_contents: Square::c() and grid.style_of() — corebake reads c()
zero_width: grid.cell_text(pos) yields the base char and its marks
scrollback_read: the grid is alacritty-derived and indexed by Line, so history is very likely readable, but the harness only read visible_rows()
damage: snapshot_visible(damage, …) and damage tracking in Crosswords
snapshot: no whole-state serializer; its screen dump is visible-only and drops marks (research part B1)
feed_loop: Processor::advance(&mut term, bytes) — corebake calls it
placements_readable: pub graphics.kitty_placements with image id, dest_row, dest_col, columns, rows — corebake reads it
placeholders: graphics.kitty_virtual_placements plus ansi/kitty_virtual.rs decoders; the U+10EEEE scan is the embedder's (with work)

cell_contents: RenderState rows and cells with resolved colours and style
snapshot: Formatter re-emits VT with modes, scrolling region, tab stops and cursor (pictures excluded)
placements_readable: PlacementIterator: image id, viewport_pos, grid_size, image pixels — ghostbake reads it
placeholders: virtual placements are flagged; positions come from the embedder's own scan (with work)
